Commentary.Commentary: World XI made a slight comeback by picking up 3 wickets in quick succession. However Shoaib Malik's breezy cameo of 38 in the end, gave his side the needed finishing touches. Imad Wasim too chipped in, in the last over, scoring 21 off it. Perera picked up a couple of wickets but gave away 51 runs in his 4 overs. Morkel, Tahir and Cutting were the others to pick up a wicket but they were expensive as well. The fielding too wasn't that great to support their bowlers. Join us back for the chase!

64 runs in the last 5 overs have ensured that Pakistan put a big score on the board! After losing Zaman in the first over, Babar Azam stepped in and took the responsibility on himself. He kept attacking the opposition and didn't play a single loose shot. Ahmed Shehzad struggled at the other end but still managed to stitch a 122-run stand for the second wicket.

SIX! Wasim finishes with a maximum! Back of a length delivery, angling across. Sits up nicely for Imad, who goes back and smashes it with authority over long on for a biggie. 21 runs off the last over! PAKISTAN END ON 197/5!
Wasim stands tall and flat-bats it towards long on for a brace.
SIX! Great pick-up shot from Wasim! Full on the pads, Wasim just flicks it away. His wristwork is superb and the ball flies over the fence. Amazing shot this, from Imad!
Leg bye! Length delivery on the pads, Ashraf fails to get bat on it. The ball hits the thigh pad and rolls away. A leg bye is taken.
Fahim Ashraf walks in at number 7. He is making his T20I debut.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Perera has his revenge! He bowls a length delivery around off, the ball doesn't bounce much. Malik looks to adjust as he looks to pull it across the line. Fails to adjust and the ball brushes the pads and hits the woodwork. Shoaib is disappointed but he has played a gem of a cameo.

SIX! That's been hammered! Perera bowls with a slightly slinging action, goes for the yorker but misses his mark. Ends up bowling a full toss. Malik gets in the position and clobbers it over mid-wicket for a maximum. He took full toll of that. Malik's cameo in the end can very well be the difference tonight!
Malik makes room for himself, Cutting follows him with an angling in delivery. Shoaib manages to punch it towards mid off for a single.
Shortish delivery, dabbed in the cover region for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.

FOUR! Hat-trick of boundaries! This is really poor bowling from Cutting. He bowls a back of a length delivery, angling down leg. Malik swivels and pulls in the fine leg region. Places it finer and the man at fine leg can't get to it. 12 runs off the over already.
FOUR! More hammering for Cutting! He bowls it a touch shorter outside off, Malik makes room and cuts it hard through point. Hits it fiercely and the ball races away to the fence.
FOUR! Poor bowling, punished! Full but on the pads, Malik gets inside the line and delicately glances it fine down the leg side for a boundary. Just the start Pakistan wanted!
Ben Cutting is back on for his final over!
Imad Wasim is the new man in! He's known for his big hits and Pakistan need them to finish on a high.

OUT! Slower one does the trick for Perera! He bowls a slower bouncer around off. Sarfraz dances down the track and looks to slash it away. Gets a feather and Paine behind the stumps accepts it gleefully. The skipper departs without scoring much. Thisara is delighted to get a wicket.
Back of a length outside off, run down to short third man for a single.

FOUR! Malik is in the mood! He gets across, Perera goes for the wide yorker but gets his length wrong. Once again Shoabi bends his knees and smashes it through cover-point for a boundary. He has got it going now.

SIX! This time Malik connects! Perera bowls a back of a hand slower one, full outside off. Shoaib bends his knees and spanks it over long off. Clears the man in the deep for his first maximum. Pakistan need more of these to finish on a high.
Full outside off, Malik takes the stance to thwack it but gets it off the toe end to mid off.
Angling into the pads, clipped with soft hands behind square on the leg side for a single.
Thisara Perera to bowl the 18th over. He's not known to be economical at the death, will he change that perception today?

Another slower ball on the shorter side. Ahmed is early into his shot as he doesn't expect it to be a slower one. Mistimes it and the ball falls in the square leg region. Another single is taken. Six singles from the over!
Another short ball, another single. Morkel once again takes the pace off the ball. Pulled to deep square leg for a single.
Slower short delivery, Ahmed flat-bats it through wide mid on for a single.
A touch ahead of a length outside off, Malik drives it on the up through covers for a run.
Ahmed gets off the mark by guiding the delivery towards third man for a single.
Wide outside off, glided to third man for a single.
Morne Morkel is back for his last over.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Skipper Sarfraz Ahmed strides out to bat.

OUT! Tahir gets his man! End of a superb knock from Babar Azam! Tossed up around middle and off, the ball spins away. Azam kneels down to slog sweep against the spin. Doesn't connect it off the meat and the ball flies high in the air. Fails to get the distance behind it and Miller at deep mid-wicket, gets underneath it and gobbles the catch with ease. Babar departs but he has done his job. Now, it's his teammates' job to provide the end flourish to this platform.
Tossed up around middle, turned on the leg side for another run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman towards long on for a single.

FIVE WIDES! Poor keeping from Paine! Anticipating the batsman to give him the charge, Tahir bowls a leg spinner wide outside off. Azam leaves it and the ball spins further away. Paine is unable to collect it and the ball races away to the third man fence. Runs being gifted to the hosts!
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Sliding into the pads, Azam goes back and punches it to long on for a single.
Imran Tahir comes back for his last over.
This is bowled outside off, Malik plays it to point. No run there.
Length ball around middle, Malik flicks it but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Lands it around middle, Babar flicks it away towards fine leg for a run.
Length ball around off, Malik guides it towards third man for a single to get off the mark.
Length ball around middle and leg, Azam works it away towards square leg for a run.
Shoaib Malik walks in next. He needs to get going from the word go!

OUT! Stunning Sammy takes a brilliant catch! Cutting bowls a back of a length ball around off and middle, Shehzad goes back and just plays a tired pull. The ball goes towards deep square leg, where Sammy runs in and dives forward to catch it inches above the ground. Ahmed was tired and was cramping at the end of the previous over. So that might have been a contributory to his downfall. This ends the 122-run stand! The bowling change works. Chance for World XI to stem the run flow now!
Ben Cutting is back on for another spell.

Ahmed Shehzad is now struggling with his fitness as well. He has started to cramp up. It's very humid out there but he has faced just 33 balls. He has had such issues in the past as well. The physio is out to treat him and Shehzad now seems fine to continue.
Darren bowls it around middle, Azam plays it towards wide long on for a brace.

SIX! Nonchalant, brilliant, maximum! Sammy bowls it full on middle and leg, Azam just lifts it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. The ball goes just over the fielder in the deep. Too good to watch the shot though.
Short ball around off and middle, Ahmed pulls it like a forehand in tennis. The ball goes to deep mid-wicket for a run.

Run out chance but missed! Sammy bowls a full toss around off, Ahmed charges down but plays it to the left of the bowler. He gets a hand onto it and parries it towards mid off. Perera there fields it and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. The ball goes towards fine leg and the batsmen run two.
Bowls it outside off, Babar plays it through covers for a run.
Slower ball around off and middle, Shehzad gets back and works it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Another short ball around off is pulled away to deep square leg for a run.
Short ball, pulled away towards short fine leg for a run.
FOUR! Just over cover! Length ball outside off, Azam goes for the aerial drive. Miller at covers leaps but is unable to reach the ball. The ball races away to the fence.
Short ball around off, Azam pulls it behind square on the leg side. Tahir gets there from deep square leg, puts in the slide and manages to save a couple of runs for his side.

DROPPED! Azam gets a life! Morkel bowls it on a length around off, Azam looks to just lift it over mid off. Miller backtracks from there, gets to the ball but is unable to hold on to that. He has a second attempt at that but still fails to cling on. Would have been a stunner had he taken that. A couple of runs taken.
Bowls it around off, Shehzad drives it through covers for a run.
Morne Morkel is back on for another spell. Will he be able to break this flourishing stand?

FOUR! Tepid delivery to end the over! Sammy strays on the pads, Azam just swivels and plays it to the left of short fine leg fielder for a boundary. Sammy's experience isn't coming to the fore here. Another good over for Pakistan, 11 runs from it!
Sammy bowls another slower ball around off, this time Shehzad charges down and plays it to long on for a run.
Slower ball in line of the stumps, Ahmed charges down and defends.
Length ball around off, Azam punches it towards covers for a run.
Bowls it in line of the stumps, Ahmed works it away in front of square on the leg side for a run. The deep mid-wicket fielder rushes to the ball and prevents the second run.
FOUR! Not the greatest of deliveries to start your spell! Sammy runs in and bowls it on the pads. Shehzad just helps it away through fine leg for a boundary. Welcome in the line of attack, Sammy!
Darren Sammy into the attack.
SIX! Out comes the biggie! Tahir tosses this up around off and middle, Azam charges down and just belts it over the bowler's head. High and handsome! The first biggie of the innings.
This quicker ball is driven towards covers.
Fires this flatter around off, Shehzad charges down and plays it towards mid off for a quick run. Du Plessis there manages a half stop but fails to prevent the single.
Floats it around middle, Azam charges out and knocks it down towards long on for a single.
Tosses this much fuller around middle and leg, Ahmed milks a run after playing that to long on.
Tahir gets away with this half tracker! Bangs it halfway down the pitch, Azam pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Azam goes back and knock it past Elliott to long on for a single. At the halfway mark, the hosts are 85/1!
Another back foot punch down to long on for a single.

FIFTY FOR AZAM! It has been a solid knock from him! He came in the first over after losing Zaman but stepped on the pedal straightaway. His partner was struggling at the other end but he kept rolling and kept the scoreboard ticking. Coming to the ball, Azam punched it off the back foot to long on for a single.
Fullish around middle, eased down to long on for a single.
The batsman has played it through mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Streaky! Short outside off, Azam goes for the back foot punch. Gets an outside edge and the ball runs past the short third man fielder for a boundary.
Flatter around middle and leg, knocked off the back foot to long on for a single.

NOT OUT! Shortish outside off, Azam comes ahead a touch and looks to cut it away. Gets a bottom edge which bounces and goes towards Paine. The Aussie collects the ball and knocks the stumps. Azam seems a to be struggling as he grounds his bat in. The umpire refers it upstairs and the replay shows that Babar is in.
Howzzat! Paine whips the bails off. A stumping appeal against Azam is referred upstairs.
Played to long off for a single.
Shorter this time from Tahir. Shehzad goes back and punches it solidly through wide mid on. The long on fielder runs to his right to make the stop. By that time, the batsmen pick a brace.
Tossed up outside off, spinning in, Azam places it in the cover-point region for a another quick single.
Tossed up outside off, Shehzad leans forward, taps it on the off side and takes a quick single.
Imran Tahir is back on!
Angling into the batsman, clipped to short fine leg.
Punched off the back foot through wide mid on for a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Angling down leg, Shehzad gets across and tickles it fine down the leg side. The ball beats the man at short fine leg and finds the fence. This will boost Ahmed's confidence!
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.

NOT OUT! Pitched around off, Shehzad dabs it on the off side and takes off for a run. The fielder there is quick to the ball and hurls a flat throw at the bowler's end. Elliott collects the ball and takes the bails off. Shehzad is confident but still the umpire goes upstairs. The replay shows that Ahmed had grounded his bat well in time.
The third umpire is referred to, for a run out appeal against Shehzad. Seems that he's just made it in.
Length delivery, angling in, knocked to long on for a single.
Grant Elliott is given the ball now. He's a useful bowler as we have seen from the various T20 leagues that he has played in.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.

Short and wide outside off, Shehzad looks to cut but ends up chopping it behind point. He runs across for a single but is lazy in his approach. A shy at the bowler's end forces Ahmed to dive in. The throw is wide and a single is completed with ease.
Wide outside off, tapped towards point for a single.
50-run stand is up between Azam and Shehzad!

This time Perera gets his hands to it. Again it's short from Cutting. Azam once again pulls it through mid-wicket. Perera has more work to do. He runs to his left, arches his back this time and collects the ball. A brace is taken. 50-run stand is up as well! Babar Azam has been the chief tormentor in this stand while Shehzad is struggling a touch!

FOUR! Poor from Perera! Back of a length delivery, angling in. Azam stands tall and pulls it along the ground through mid-wicket. Perera in the deep hares to his left, tries to stop with his foot. It's an ordinary effort and the ball sneaks underneath to reach the fence.

FOUR! Classy! Azam is looking in a sublime touch. Cutting bowls a slower one, full outside off. Babar waits for the ball to come to him and then unleashes a superb off drive. Once again gets it through the gap between extra cover and mid off for another boundary.

Shehzad gives it a charge. Tahir spots that and fires it shorter outside off. Ahmed mistimes his punch to covers and takes off for a quick single. Azam, however, is not interested and sends his partner back. A fumble in the field allows Shehzad to return back with ease.
Loopy delivery on middle, flicked in the same region for a single.
Full around middle and leg, Azam prods ahead and turns it in front of square on the leg side for a brace.
A touch shortish outside off, punched to covers.

FOUR! Googly, tossed up around off, Azam comes forward a touch and drives it through the off side. Pierces the gap between extra cover and mid off to find the fence. Excellent placement, this! Babar Azam has looked solid so far!
Slider on middle, punched off the back foot to long on for a single.
Imran Tahir will bowl the last over of the Powerplay!
Length ball in line of the stumps, Shehzad dances down and drives it down. Mid on fields that. A run taken.
Bowls it around off, Azam collects a single after playing it to the off side.
This ball is flicked away through square leg for a run.
Short ball around off, Ahmed pulls it in front of square on the leg side. The fielder from deep square leg gets there and keeps them to two.

Dropped! A tough chance though! Length ball around off, Shehzad gets a leading edge back to the bowler. It was dipping on Cutting who puts in the dive to his left, gets his left hand on that but fails to cling on.
WIDE! Bowls this down the leg side, Ahmed looks to flick but misses. Wide signaled.
Length ball in line of the stumps, worked away round the corner for a run.
Ben Cutting is into the attack now.

FOUR! Glorious! Gracious! Perera lands this on a length around middle and leg, Shehzad just times it brilliantly through the right of mid on. The ball just races away to the fence like people rush home from their offices!
Bowls it outside off, Azam drives it towards cover-point where Elliott makes a diving stop. A run taken.

FOUR! Edged but effective! Perera bowls a length ball outside off, Azam looks to slash that to the off side. Gets an edge that flies through where a slip would have been. The flow of runs in front of the wicket made the skipper shift the slip fielder and that's where this ball went through for a boundary.
This delivery in line of the stumps is pushed towards mid on.
Length ball around off, Ahmed taps this towards cover-point off the back foot for a quick run.
Perera bowls it on the pads again, is lucky this time as the flick from Shehzad finds Morkel at short fine leg.
Morkel bowls a slower bouncer around off, Azam looks to pull but is early into the shot. Ends up missing the ball completely.
Length ball around off, Babar defends it from within the crease.
Spears it around off, Azam pushes it towards covers.
Length ball on the pads, Azam works it through square leg for a brace.
Bowls it around off, driven by Babar crisply to covers.
This one is on off, Shehzad works it towards mid on for a run.
This is the slower delivery around off, Babar drives it down the ground. The mid off player makes a diving stop.

FOUR! And another one! This isn't great bowling to be honest. With fine leg inside the circle, Perera bowls it on the pads again. Azam works it to the left of short fine leg fielder for another boundary.
FOUR! And the boundary flow continues! Perera strays on the pads, Azam just had to get bat to that and he does. The ball races away to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Length ball on the pads, worked away through square leg for a run.
This is bowled around off, pushed to the cover region.
Perera starts off with a length ball around off, Shehzad gets a leading edge to the left of the bowler as he looks to work this away to the leg side.
The Sri Lankan all-rounder Thisara Perera will share the new ball. He too has a lone slip in place.
Bowls it outside off, Azam shoulders arms to that. Exciting over to begin! 12 runs and a wicket!
FOUR! Azam gets going with a boundary! Morkel bangs this short around off, Azam pulls this through mid-wicket for a boundary. Good start to get going.
Babar Azam walks in at the fall of the first wicket.

OUT! Catching practice for Amla! And he's too good to drop these! Morkel bowls it on a length just outside off, Zaman just guides it to the first slip fielder. Fakhar is very disappointed with this. He looked eager to perform in front of the home crowd and he got the start as well. But, might have got carried away a touch. Excellent beginning to the series - two boundaries followed by a wicket!
Length ball around off, punched to the covers.

FOUR! Short, wide, punished! He bowls it outside off, Zaman slaps it through cover-point for another boundary. He is very strong in that area as we saw it in the Champions Trophy, 2017. Back-to-back boundaries to start off!

FOUR! Morkel runs in from round the wicket and spears this delivery at a back of a length around off. Zaman looks to hit it through the off side, ends up getting an inside edge past the leg stump for a boundary. Pakistan are off with a boundary. What a return to the home soil for the Men in Green!

The Pakistan national anthem is played, post which, the men who matter take the field. Ahmed Shehzad and Fakhar Zaman stride out on their home soil with bat in hand. Morne Morkel will start with the new ball. He has a slip in place. Let's roll...
World XI - Tamim Iqbal, Hashim Amla, Faf du Plessis (C), David Miller, Grant Elliott, Thisara Perera, Tim Paine (WK), Ben Cutting, Darren Sammy, Morne Morkel, Imran Tahir.
PAKISTAN XI: Ahmed Shehzad, Fakhar Zaman, Babar Azam, Shoaib Malik, Sarfraz Ahmed (C/WK), Imad Wasim, Fahim Ashraf, Shadab Khan, Sohail Khan, Hasan Ali, Rumman Raees.
PITCH REPORT - Pommie Mbangwa observes that there's not too much grass on the surface. Dryness means that it might turn he says. Feels that 160 should get you in the game. Expects a good game.

Sarfraz Ahmed says that they were looking to bat anyway. Informs that the players are excited as 8 of them are playing at home for the first time and it would be exciting for them. Affirms that their attention is on the game and they let bygones be bygones. He concludes that he is happy with the composition of the side and is looking forward to the game.

Faf du Plessis informs that they are going to have a bowl first as the conditions are new for them. Opines that they have a deep batting order and it gives them the opportunity to see the wicket first. Mentions that it's an honour to lead the World XI side and is happy to play a small part in bringing cricket back to Pakistan. Adds that there are no clashes of egos in the team as it's a relaxed bunch of players. Ends by saying that they will have to play at their best as Pakistan are a dangerous side.
TOSS - Sarfraz Ahmed tosses up the coin. 'Heads' is the call from du Plessis and 'Heads' it is. WORLD XI OPT TO FIELD!

The fans would be coming in numbers to watch the Men in Green play at home and would be rooting at the top of their voices, showing their support. Pakistan players too would be eager to perform in front of their home crowd and would be high on confidence after their Champions Trophy victory. However, they face a stern test against the World XI, which is formed by the top players around the world. The ground would be buzzing in excitement and let's hope that the players don't let the fans down and we get to see a thrilling encounter. Stay tuned!

Are you excited? Why won't you be! Cricket is returning to Pakistan and they are going to play the World XI for the Independence Cup. The players from across the globe have gathered here to celebrate the spirit of the game. It's a 3-match T20I series and all the matches will be played at Gaddafi Stadium, Lahore. This is the first international series to be held in Pakistan after Zimbabwe visited last in 2015.
